name: pictograph
description: Real-time vision tools for agents and developers. Teaches Claude Code the Pictograph CLI and Python SDK: upload and label image datasets, draft labels with SAM3, train RF-DETR, YOLOX and Segformer models, deploy them as GPU endpoints, stream live RTSP or WebRTC video to them, and run trained models as tools.

api_key.title: Pictograph API key
api_key.description: From app.pictograph.io, Settings, API Keys. Set as PICTOGRAPH_API_KEY for the session's commands. Leave empty to use your own PICTOGRAPH_API_KEY or `pictograph login` instead.
